title: Chung Soong Yang

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE.
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

November 9th 1918

Sir,
The subordinate officers and soldiers at Sungkiang
Have complained to General Yang that Colonel Chung
Soong Yang 宋声扬 who was transferred from Sungkiang
to Shanghai about a month ago used to embezzle part
of their pay and the money allowed for rations.
General Yang intends to investigate the matter on 10th
instant.
General Yang has instructed his detectives to
make careful enquiries re the Manchu Restoration Party.
There is good reason to believe that the number
of rebels who left Shanghai since the repatriation
scheme started exceeds five thousand.
The ex rebel leader Han Hwe has sent a telegram
in the name of the Shanghai Labour Party to Nanking
congratulating Vice President Feng Kou Chang.
Han Hwe claims that 9,600 workers in Shanghai
recognise him as their Chief.

Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
Detective Sub Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

I. O. REG
编号....................
日期..................
（批注：C.H）

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处
（侦探分部）

1918年11月9日

先生：

松江的下级军官和士兵已向杨将军投诉，约一个月前从松江调往上海的钟松扬（宋声扬）上校曾侵吞他们部分薪饷及伙食津贴。

杨将军拟于本月10日调查此事。

杨将军已指示其侦探人员就满清复辟党一事进行仔细查访。

有充分理由相信，自遣返计划开始以来，离开上海的叛乱分子人数已超过五千。

前叛乱首领韩恢以“上海劳工党”的名义向南京发送电报，祝贺副总统冯国璋。

韩恢声称，上海有9,600名工人承认他是他们的领袖。

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
侦探副督察。

警察总监。

Form 2    31
Shanghai Municipal Police.
Sinza    Station.
November 9 th    191 6.
REPORT ON    Distribution of Steamer Tickets.
Made by    Det. Insp. Fitzgibbon.    Forwarded by Inspector Rivers.
Sir,
Between 10 a.m. & 4 p.m. on the 9 th
instant at 367/8 Avenue Edward VII General Lee Tsun Woo李徵五
handed a Steamer Ticket to each of 246 Revolutionary Ex. Soldiers
who have already agreed to leave Shanghai. No money having
been distributed to day.
I am told that more tickets will be issued on the 10 th inst.
yours obediently,
Maurice Fitzgibbon.
Det. Insp.
Hannay. C. A.
for Chief Detective Inspector.

表格 2    31
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
新闸捕房。
1916年11月9日。

关于轮船票分发情况的报告。

由侦探督察菲茨吉本（Fitzgibbon）呈报。经督察里弗斯（Rivers）转呈。

先生：

本月9日上午10时至下午4时之间，在爱多亚路367/8号，李徵五将军向246名已同意离开上海的革命退伍士兵每人发放了一张轮船票。今日未分发钱款。

据告知，本月10日将发放更多船票。

您顺从的仆人，
莫里斯·菲茨吉本
侦探督察

汉纳 C. A.
代首席侦探督察
